MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Stick feels like a useful next step for my existing TV because it adds streaming; I would choose it for that function, provided it connects properly, rather than for 4K.",
    "The battery backup fits my repeated purchases of power strips and surge protectors because it adds a practical benefit: keeping essential electronics running during a power interruption."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show stand and Arlo Chime need specific devices I have not indicated owning. My interest in mounts and accessories only carries over when they fit equipment I actually use.",
    "The advanced HDMI cable offers capabilities my 720p TV gives me little reason to seek, while the Fire TV Ethernet adapter addresses a connection problem I have not encountered yet.",
    "The Echo devices, landline call blocker, and home improvement protection plan do not address a current need shown by my purchases. Having a tablet or other electronics does not make those natural next choices."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been treated as interest in more Amazon devices, even though my purchases mostly concern specific practical uses.",
    "Buying cables, mounts, and power accessories seems to have been taken as interest in any electronic accessory, regardless of compatibility or whether I need its added features."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My accessory purchases usually have an identifiable purpose, such as storing memory cards, reading them, charging a device, or mounting equipment. A recommendation needs that same clear connection to something I use.",
    "My existing equipment and the order of my needs matter: streaming could add a useful function to my TV, but I would try Wi-Fi before buying a network adapter and would not seek advanced video specifications for their own sake.",
    "My repeated power-strip purchases and recent camera accessory purchase give more concrete clues about useful next purchases than a broad interest in connected home devices."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in useful electronics upgrades but stretched it into devices and accessories without a clear need or compatible equipment."
}
